svg.title: Before the prompt
svg.desc: Flow diagram of the Hermes Agent v0.22.5 dangerous-command approval path: a command meets the dangerous-command detector; unflagged commands bypass this gate and are not thereby known safe; flagged commands are routed by the configured mode — manual goes to a human approval prompt with once, session, always or deny; smart goes first to an auxiliary model whose verdicts are approve (that one command only), deny (blocks, or a once-or-deny override in an interactive session) or escalate (follows the human approval path); off skips this gate while separate hard stops remain. Labelled: source audit, not live observation.

text.tspan: The dangerous-command path in Hermes v0.22.5 — how a flagged command is routed.
Hermes Agent v0.22.5 implementation; source audit, not live observation.
An approval prompt is not the whole control system — it is one visible point in a chain.
